name: Hero split image 03
summary: Hero section named after the Untitled UI layout of the same name: copy on the left with two buttons, a framed photo on the right. Rebuilt in our own HTML and CSS from DS tokens and the DS button and input styles; every picture is a real of the DS placeholder image. No third-party code, text or assets.
highlights: White surface: black headline, secondary-grey text, Vivid Pink label, DS primary and default button styles
Layout: copy on the left with two buttons, a framed photo on the right; container 1280px; stacks at 991px and tightens at 479px in its own container width
Every picture slot is a real pointing at the DS placeholder image (marketing-assets/image-placeholder.svg), cropped to the layout's slot by CSS; swap its src and alt for the page image
Headline, text, labels, button labels and links, and the images are per-page content
Reads only shared --aha-* tokens: no new colours, radii or raw sizes; controls are 48px high
